name: Caldera House
insider_take: Jackson Hole's most exclusive alpine retreat where luxury meets authentic Western hospitality in the heart of Teton Village.
whats_special: Caldera House is Jackson Hole's first ultra-luxury boutique hotel, featuring just 40 suites and residences with ski-in/ski-out access to Jackson Hole Mountain Resort. The property sits at 6,311 feet elevation with direct views of the iconic Teton Range, and each suite includes a private hot tub on the terrace - perfect for soaking while watching the sunset over the peaks.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite on the upper floors for unobstructed 180-degree mountain views, and don't miss the complimentary s'mores service by the outdoor fire pits each evening.
dont_miss: The hotel's exclusive Aprés experience at the rooftop bar overlooking the slopes, and easy access to the famous Corbet's Couloir - one of the most challenging ski runs in North America. In summer, you're minutes from the Jackson Hole Aerial Tram and world-class hiking in Grand Teton National Park.
pros: Luxury ski-in/ski-out access to Jackson Hole Mountain Resort
Spacious residences with full kitchens and premium amenities
Stunning views of the Teton Range and valley
Exclusive access to private club amenities and concierge services
cons: Seasonal availability may be limited during peak periods
